plugin_voice_input_description: Hold the voice input hotkey and talk: what you say is typed into the game chat (after the blocklist, polishing or translation if you set them up)
plugin_voice_input_off_note: When it's on, hold the voice input hotkey and talk to type into the game chat. Calling her and the wake word keep working while it's off, and she can still speak in the chat for you.
plugin_voice_input_asr_desc: Kotone's speech recognition turns what you say into text; calling her uses the same one. Change the model, download it or start it in Settings.
plugin_voice_input_asr_not_downloaded: The local model isn't downloaded yet
plugin_voice_input_push_sent_when: Voice input sends a line to the game chat; lines to the same game and channel within 2 minutes of the previous one go into the same card
plugin_voice_input_push_sent_what: Posts a card: what you sent to which channel (the processed text, plus the original when it differs); leaves her a short note so she knows what you said in the game
plugin_voice_input_push_failed_when: A voice input line didn't make it into the game chat
plugin_voice_input_push_failed_what: Posts a card saying why it wasn't sent, with a Resend button; it only resends when you click it, back into the game window it was meant for
plugin_voice_input_event_failed: A voice input line wasn't sent
plugin_voice_input_card_resend_title: Send it again to the same game window and channel
plugin_voice_input_card_empty: Voice input pushes in the chat open here.
